title: Blinded receiver-local uptake study for Living Bible transformations
status: experimental scaffold; no human-subject data collected

receiver.definition: adult English reader; no source-language competence assumed
receiver.boundary: The receiver definition scopes the measurement. It is not a claim about all readers.

blinding.method: deterministic study-scoped pseudonym + SHA-256 arm allocation + participant-specific item order
blinding.participant_surface: The public assignment contains opaque material tokens but no version identity or source URL.
blinding.presenter_surface: A separate resolver maps the token to ASV or TLB. Version metadata must not be shown with the passage.

materials.reason: Do not vendor copyrighted TLB wording. A presenter retrieves the cited rendering at run time and displays only the passage text.

measurement.separation_law: Preference, perceived fidelity, theological agreement, and comprehension remain distinct fields.
measurement.default_report: descriptive arm-local rates and TLB-minus-ASV comprehension delta only after minimum cell size

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may increase recovery of the present-time fulfillment relation.
items.prompt: According to the sentence, when is the scriptural promise presented as being fulfilled?

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may make the Sabbath-for-human purpose relation more explicit.
items.prompt: Which direction of purpose does the sentence assert?
options: Human beings exist to serve the Sabbath
The Sabbath exists for human beings
Both exist only for religious officials

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may increase recovery of the one-day-at-a-time relation.
items.prompt: How does the saying divide trouble across time?
options: Tomorrow's trouble should be solved today
Today's trouble is enough for today
All trouble is treated as one undivided burden

items.hypothesis: Both carriers should make the rank reversal recoverable.
options: The last become first and the first become last
The poor become rich and the rich become poor
The young become old and the old become young

items.hypothesis: Both carriers should make the access relation recoverable.
items.prompt: By what route does the saying describe access to the Father?

items.hypothesis: Both carriers should preserve the claim that the speaker precedes Abraham.
items.prompt: Relative to Abraham, when does the speaker locate his own existence?
options: The sentence denies any temporal relation

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may reduce recovery of the source-layer becoming/present-being contrast.
items.prompt: Which more specific grammatical contrast is tracked by the source-layer analysis?
options: Abraham speaks while the speaker is silent
Abraham remembers while the speaker forgets
Abraham moves while the speaker rests
Abraham comes-to-be while the speaker uses present being

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may reduce recovery of the explicit generation referent.
items.prompt: What temporal group-word is explicitly tracked in the source-layer relation?

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may increase recovery of one particular interpretation of the first 'dead' group.
items.prompt: Which interpretation of the first group is made explicit in the tracked paraphrase relation?
options: They are spiritually dead or without eternal life

items.hypothesis: The paraphrase may increase recovery of a celebratory interpretation of the stones' cry.
items.prompt: What kind of vocal response does the tracked paraphrase interpretation assign to the stones?

analysis_boundaries: Do not combine comprehension with preference into a single score.
Do not treat perceived fidelity as source-language fidelity.
Do not infer population effects before declared sampling and adequate cell sizes.
Do not interpret PROJECTION comprehension as proof that the projected interpretation is correct.
Do not use reader response to rewrite CARRY/REVEAL/PROJECTION/LOSS source declarations.
